title: The affine etale site of a limit of schemes is the colimit of the affine etale sites

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336) and its proof, which uses Limits Lemmas Tag 01ZM (descend-finite-presentation), Tag 01Z6 (limit-affine), Tag 07RP (descend-etale), Tag 07RR (descend-surjective), Tag 0EY1 (descend-finite-presentation-variant); the colimit of sites is Sites Lemma Tag 09YL

proof.text: Choose U, v, p, q, gamma and delta from the coherent base-change-system theorem. This supplies exactly the first fifteen conjuncts, including continuity and adjoints on Type u sheaves.
Apply affineEtale_descent_data to the chosen pullback squares, delta projection equation and preservation of covers. It supplies object descent and the Fin n covering equivalence.

Prove map descent directly from exists_pullback_hom_of_isLimit: convert the map by the q-pullback isomorphism, descend its composite with q_B, lift it to the U_B pullback, then use naturality of q, the delta projection equation and pullback uniqueness to obtain the delta conjugation formula. Prove eventual equality directly from exists_pullback_fst_comp_eq_of_isLimit: naturality of q converts equality under v into equality after the limit first projection; descend that equality and use naturality of p and pullback extensionality at the resulting stage. Affine domains over quasi-separated bases are of finite presentation by the recorded qcqs permanence instances.

Apply exists_affineEtale_colimit_presentation to the chosen coherence, site properties, object descent, the two directly proved morphism-descent clauses, and covering descent. Reassemble the witnesses and all twenty conjuncts without changing the statement.

split_report.summary: Split along the first paragraph of the Stacks proof of 0EYL (qcqs case); the statement is restricted to qcqs X_i, as the source does first and as all users (lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-limit-of-schemes, step 3, with affine X_i) need, and made explicit in five clauses. Steps: (1) the schemes are qcqs and the objects of the affine sites are of finite presentation, base change preserves affine etale objects; (2) continuity from the reviewed lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous; (3) morphisms of sites by transporting h^{-1} (finite-limit preserving, reviewed nodes) along the equivalences of lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos, an argument the source leaves tacit; (4) the canonical isomorphisms of iterated fibre products and a new strictification node, since Situation 0A34 needs u_b u_a = u_c exactly and base change is only pseudo-functorial (the source passes over this); (5) objects by 01ZM(1) (cited through thm-pd-spreading-out), 01YZ, 01Z6 (Mathlib leaf) and 07RP; (6) morphisms by 01ZM(2),(3); (7) coverings by 07RR applied to the finite disjoint union; (8) the comparison functor from the colimit site of lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites. New nodes: lem-weil-pbc-scheme-over-limit (01YZ), lem-weil-pbc-descend-etale (07RP), lem-weil-pbc-descend-surjective (07RR), lem-weil-pbc-site-system-strictification (unsplit); lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-stage (01Z6), lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence, lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence (Mathlib leaves). The 00U2(9) node lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-filtered-colimit-descent is not used: the Stacks route descends a given finitely presented morphism (07RP), not an etale algebra; it would only replace 01ZM(1)+01Z6+07RP when all X_i are affine.
